text: dsh-effort-slider 是面向 DSH Web 的思考强度插件：它在模型菜单中把「推理等级」入口替换为可连续拖动的浮动滑块，松手后吸附到模型档位，并将选择写入当前会话共享模型目录。面板显示 OFF、Low、Medium、High、Ultracode 等状态，带有 WebGL 火焰轨道，菜单行和模型座位会保留档位颜色。宿主端为缺少推理元数据的 pi-ai 自定义模型补充档位及可选协议方言，也支持目录模型覆盖；通过 DSH profile 配置默认方言、路由覆盖和诊断日志。适合在 DSH Web 中调整原生或自定义模型的思考强度；需 DSH 0.2.1 系列服务，不需另配密钥。

dsh-effort-slider adds a five-level reasoning slider to the DSH web model menu. Drag to adjust effort; release snaps to a level and updates the current session. A WebGL fire trail follows the control. The host provisions effort metadata for custom pi-ai models. Profile options select route dialects.

Let me change effort for the current session without switching models.
dsh-effort-slider 的功能「连续调节思考强度」：点击模型菜单的「推理等级」行打开面板，在 0–100 滑轨上拖动并实时提交当前模型的档位；松手、失焦或键盘操作结束时吸附到最近档位并再次确认。
dsh-effort-slider 的功能「自定义模型档位」：当前模型没有声明推理档位时，面板使用 OFF、Low、Medium、High、Ultracode 五档；宿主为适用的 pi-ai 模型补写档位映射，按全局或路由方言生成配置。
dsh-effort-slider 的功能「路由方言映射」：可配置默认或逐路由方言；宿主按协议写入 reasoningEfforts 和适用的 compat 字段，支持八种方言。
dsh-effort-slider 的功能「档位状态着色」：插件识别模型菜单和模型座位中的 Effort 文案，将档位名称按等级着色；面板关闭或官方菜单重新渲染后仍会扫描并刷新颜色。
dsh-effort-slider 的功能「供给诊断」：开启 debugReport 后，宿主记录逐模型供给决策及 llm/stream 请求携带的 route、model 和 effort。
dsh-effort-slider 使用前须知：自定义线方言仅在路由声明 api=openai-completions 时写入 compat 以影响线级映射；其他协议只补充档位元数据，需按实际路由协议选择配置。

@txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider README · Features：| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 🎚️ Stepless dragging | Continuous 0–100 dragging that writes `reasoningEffort` in real time (16 ms throttle, no request pile-up while dragging) |
| 🎯 Snap on release | Snaps to the nearest level on release / blur / keyboard end, with one confirmation write |
| 🔥 WebGL fire trail | Three-pass shaders (ignite → blur → composite); the fire front follows the thumb with spring damping |
| 🏁 OFF/MAX ticks | First/last levels always show `OFF` / `MAX`; middle levels show the API-returned name |
| 🎨 Level status | Effort name shown in the panel header, colored/glowing per level; menu row and model-seat trigger keep the same color after closing (v0.2.3) |
| 🌐 Universal effort | Third-party models without `reasoning` metadata automatically get the universal 5-level scale; pi-ai models get wire-level dictionaries patched in, **hot-applied** (v0.2.0) |

@txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider README · Features：Only `reasoningEffort` is written — model selection is untouched. Models with no multi-level reasoning show 「当前模型不提供多档推理等级」 (no multi-level reasoning available).

@txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider README · Universal effort provisioning (v0.2.0, simplified in v0.3.0)：> **Why there is no adapter wrapper any more.** Up to v0.2.5 the host half also wrapped each adapter's `resolveModel` to inject
> `universalReasoning` into models that declared no `reasoning` metadata. DSH 0.1.5 made `llm.adapters` a private field with no
> public accessor, so that path is impossible — and unnecessary: `reasoningEfforts` is the one declaration that feeds both the
> request wire and the model catalog. Model-level `compat` is only written when the route declares `api: openai-completions`,
> because pi-ai refuses a switch the model's protocol cannot read.

@txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider README · Quick Start：1. Install the plugin, restart DSH, press `Ctrl+F5`.
2. Open the model menu above the composer → click **Effort** → the Effort slider panel appears.
3. Drag to choose a level; it snaps on release. After the panel closes, the effort value keeps its color on the menu row.
4. For custom models with no thinking effort, the panel opens with the universal 5-level scale; pi-ai models get their wire dictionaries patched on the host side (hot-applied).

@txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider README · Permissions & Data：| Scope | What it touches |
| --- | --- |
| Files (read) | None — no user files are read or written (settings go through DSH's settings service) |
| Network | None of its own — the panel reads and writes the Model Controller's in-browser directory; the resulting `session.selectModel` call rides DSH's existing connection |
| Credentials | Never read |
| User data | Not read (no access to conversation content/messages/prompts; only the current session's provider/model/`reasoningEffort` through the shared model directory) |

@txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider README · How It Works：| Half | File | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Universal effort provisioning: locates the pi-ai profile entry (`llm-pi-ai`), reads it via `settings.describe()`, patches wire dialects (`buildProvisionOps`, idempotent, respects user declarations) via `settings.mutate`; listens to `llm/adapters-updated` / `settings/document-updated`. With `debugReport: true`, each provisioning run logs a per-route/per-model report (written fields or skip reason, plus a note where the wire dialect does not apply) instead of the one-line count, and each model call is traced as `[debug] request route=… model=… effort=…` through a read-only `llm/stream` passthrough |
| Browser | `lib/client.js` | Captures clicks on the model menu's Effort row → shows the Effort panel; reads `ctx.modelDirectories.directoryFor(sessionId)` and writes through `directory.select({ reasoningEffort })`; a MutationObserver keeps the menu-row level color alive after the panel closes |

@txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| `duplicate factory registration for "dsh-effort-slider"` followed by `web boot: 1 entry did not activate` | npm 0.5.1 shipped a stale client factory with the unscoped name. Install the rebuilt v0.5.2 package into the affected profile, then restart DSH. Repeated reloads cannot correct the installed artifact. The unscoped `dsh-effort-slider` npm package is maintained separately; this project's factory id must be `@txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider` |
| No Effort row in the model menu | The model declares no reasoning metadata and host provisioning is not in effect — confirm DSH was restarted and check `enabled` on the plugin's settings page (its profile entry config); set `debugReport: true` and check the host log for the per-model provisioning report |
| Panel says 「当前模型不支持思考强度调节」 | Universal fallback not active — upgrade to v0.2.0+ and restart |
| Plugin does not load at all (row shows `disabled: true`) | An earlier build was switched off in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`; delete that row and restart |
| Dragging has no effect | Check whether the target endpoint's wire dialect matches

text: @txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider README · Set DSH_TEST_VERSION=0.2.1-rc.4 to validate the desktop log's runtime version.：CI runs both test commands for rc.4 and rc.5. On Windows, test runtimes, profiles, screenshots and reports go under `E:\Codex\Workspace\dsh-effort-slider-20261101`, with process temporary files under `E:\Codex\Temp`; other platforms use ignored `output/`. Set `DSH_TEST_WORKSPACE` to override the evidence directory. Live checks cover configuration, the model directory and Session selection without sending a model generation request. Historical fixture tests are excluded from the release checks. `npm pack` and publishing run `prepack`, rebuilding and checking the shipped artifact.
section: Set DSH_TEST_VERSION=0.2.1-rc.4 to validate the desktop log's runtime version.

text: @txc2768651338/dsh-effort-slider README · Set DSH_TEST_VERSION=0.2.1-rc.4 to validate the desktop log's runtime version.：The hot-update bridge feature-detects DSH 0.2.1's internal HMR transaction context before enqueueing work. Settings writes still use the revision-checked public API and its exclusive queue. The live test defaults to rc.5; CI also pins rc.4 so changes to that internal context are caught when updating the supported version.
